summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 75 yen for fiscal year ending September 2026, up 30 yen from prior guidance of 45 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year profit forecasts driven by stronger-than-expected orders in school meal and institutional catering segments and improved material cost management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending September 2026 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Nitcho Corporation has revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, raising the annual dividend per share from the previously guided 45 yen to 75 yen, an increase of 30 yen. This revision follows an upward revision of the company's full-year business forecasts announced on the same date.

The earnings upside reflects stronger-than-expected order intake in two key segments: school meal facility operations (including cafeteria centers serving educational institutions) and institutional catering beyond school meals (corporate employee cafeterias and hotels). Additionally, the company has made progress in addressing material cost inflation pressures that emerged during the fiscal year.

As a result of these operational improvements, the company now forecasts full-year operating profit of 1,344 million yen (up 524 million yen or 63.9% from prior guidance), ordinary profit of 1,360 million yen, and net income of 912 million yen, with earnings per share of 204.70 yen. The dividend increase to 75 yen per share reflects management's confidence in sustaining this improved earnings trajectory.
